title: Traveloot
notes: Traveloot, by Fluffy Lotus. Unity 6000.0.44f1 game. Ran on dxmt through the Highball Wine 11 (r27) engine (x64-crossover26.3-r27) with Highball's launch environment (HighballKit), launched from the macOS Steam client via Proton-ish (https://github.com/MagnusPladsen/Proton-ish). Everything worked well, no issues noticed.
session: Played for 60 min, launched from macOS Steam through Proton-ish.
